extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser toolbar and store listing.

extDescription.description: Short extension description shown in the store listing.

authLoading.description: Shown while checking the current connection status.

authConnectButton.description: Button to start the OAuth login flow.

tabSearch.description: Tab label for the search screen.

refreshButton.description: Accessible label for the manual refresh icon button.

settingsThemeAuto.description: Theme option following the system preference.

settingsThemeLight.description: Theme option forcing the light palette.

searchNoResults.message: No channel or game matches that.
